title: Before/after pair metadata (meta.json, one per pair folder)

pair_id.description: Unique ID, e.g. 'clinic01-0001'. Must match the folder name.

brand.description: Implant brand, if the clinic recorded it.

volume_cc.description: Implant volume in cc. If left/right differ, record the average and note it.

months_post_op.description: Months between surgery and the 'after' photo. 3+ preferred (settled result).

clothing.description: What the subject is wearing in BOTH photos (pairs must match).

consent_ref.description: Reference to the signed clinic agreement + patient release covering AI training, e.g. 'clinic01-agreement-2026-05'. Pairs without this are rejected at ingest.
